propositions: Logger level leaked from rebar_reconciler root to subsequent tests when reconciler entrypoint runs in-process, causing INFO-level assertions to fail because isEnabledFor filters at originating logger before caplog handler sees the record
caplog.at_level(INFO) without logger= argument raises only ROOT logger level, not intermediate rebar_reconciler logger, leaving INFO records dropped at source while WARNING records propagate
Existing test-infrastructure guard _rebar_log_propagation_guard hardcoded to single root 'rebar' and misses sibling 'rebar_reconciler' root documented in _logging.py module docstring

Test test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal because preceding test running reconciler main() poisons rebar_reconciler logger to WARNING level
Fix generalizes _log_integrity.py primitives from scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to tuple SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES and makes conftest guard snapshot/restore level for both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots
Production behavior is unaffected: confirm_store is None case correctly applies removal (no decline), and per-item decline line in failure capture proves storeful path was taken
